effect_description_eng:
[Opponent's Turn] When a card is removed from your security stack, ＜De-Digivolve 1＞ 1 of your opponent's Digimon. (Trash the top card. You can't trash past level 3 cards.)
[On Deletion] ＜Recovery +1 (Deck)＞. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -4000 DP for the turn for each card in your security stack.
